name.zh: 纳索斯蒂植物形态研究

description.en: Genus-level reconstruction, not a complete fossil or single age-stage. Richter1909 actual text/PlateX supports unbranched stems, expanded narrow leaf bases, meridional basal depressions and root scars. Historical reproductive speculation is not adopted. A teaching reconstruction is secondary visual context, not primary proof. Nominal22cm includes artistic root spread/crown; exact colors,12 ribs,20 leaves and18 roots are design counts not taxonomic constants. Root form and basal development vary with age and preservation.
